text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: It's almost post time... All right! I'm definitely going to win this race!
choice_data_list: You're raring to go, aren't you.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
But at times like this, it's all the more important to stay calm and prepare thoroughly for the race.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
My shoes are reset and my stretching is done.
All that's left is to review the data, I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Applying the latest data just to be safe...
Ah, looks like I need to keep an eye on this girl too.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: In that case, I'd like to rethink that last plan we considered—Trainer, could we hold a meeting?
choice_data_list: Sure, let's prepare thoroughly again this time.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Yes! Just as every magic trick has its secret, every victory has its underlying factors—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: "If we maximize our chances to the absolute limit, the crown will surely be ours!"

Gazing toward the future with unwavering eyes,
Satono Crown inspired a deep sense of reliability.
